title: Delegation-friendly regional release handoff
initial_prompt: Read TASK.md. Coordinate a release-readiness review across capacity, security, and billing. The workstreams are independent until final integration. You may delegate them with native tools or work serially; neither choice changes the score. Keep concise durable notes and identify owners.

stages.message: Read TASK.md. Coordinate a release-readiness review across capacity, security, and billing. The workstreams are independent until final integration. You may delegate them with native tools or work serially; neither choice changes the score. Keep concise durable notes and identify owners.

The capacity team supplied peak demand and replica ceilings in inputs/capacity.json. Required replicas are ceil(peak_rps*10/(capacity_per_replica_rps*7)); recommended_replicas is max(current_replicas,required). Capacity blocks when recommended exceeds max_replicas. Produce provisional capacity findings.

Security supplied revisioned findings and waivers. Select highest revision per finding_id. Inactive findings do not block. Active critical findings always block, even with a waiver. Active high findings block unless a matching-region waiver expires on or after 2026-10-01. Medium/low findings do not block. Keep exact finding IDs.

Finance supplied hourly prices and monthly budgets. Proposed monthly cost is recommended_replicas*720*hourly_cents, including services already blocked elsewhere. A cost strictly above budget adds a budget blocker; equality is allowed. Do not trade security or capacity against budget.

Architecture supplied same-region service dependencies. A service with no direct blocker is still blocked when any transitive dependency has a direct blocker. blocked_by lists all such transitive service IDs sorted, excluding the service itself. Do not duplicate inherited work as owner actions.

Late security revisions and corrected waiver scopes are now included in the cumulative security snapshot. Reconcile workstream notes against current source data and finalize all three artifacts. The release remains a partial rollout: do not reject every region merely because one region has a blocker. Retain early rules and no secret compensating controls.
